audit_items.proof_trace: The fee is partially diverted to the protocol's Referral object (referee and referrer rebates) when a referral code is active, so cash_reserve receives fee minus rebates rather than the full fee. This behaviour is intentional by design: rebates stay within the protocol's Referral bag and are only claimable via a separate explicit transaction, callers cannot self-refer (owner != user check), and the full protocol-determined fee is always collected from the caller before any split occurs.
